name: Toast
description:
One toast: a title, optional description, leading icon, action button and close button.

Toasts live inside a Toaster. Render them on the server (flash messages, or appended with Turbo Streams: `turbo_stream.append "toaster", AppicaUI::Toast.new(title: "Saved")`), or create them in the browser with `AppicaUI.toast.add({ title: "Saved" })`. Either way the `appica-ui--toaster` controller stacks, times, animates and dismisses them.

  Toast(title: "Payment received", description: "Invoice #1024 has been settled.", icon: :success)
  Toast(title: "Message archived", action: { label: "Undo", href: undo_path })
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Toast(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

ToastIcon.description: The leading glyph of a toast: success, error, warning, info, loading (a spinner) or bell. `thumbnail: true` wraps it in a tinted badge for more prominence.

ToastTrigger.description:
Fires a toast from a button without writing JavaScript. The toast options go in `toast:` (the same keys as AppicaUI.toast.add: title, description, icon, thumbnail, action, timeout, priority, position). A block taking an argument puts the attributes on your own element:

  ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "Changes saved" }) { |trigger| Button(**trigger) { "Save" } }

Toaster.description:
The toast viewport. Render it once, near the end of your layout's <body>:

  Toaster()                                              # bottom-right, 5s, 3 visible
  Toaster(position: :top_center, progress: true, toasts: flash_toasts)

It renders a viewport per corner/edge (the default one has id="toaster" for Turbo Streams), any server-side toasts, and <template>s the `appica-ui--toaster` controller clones for toasts created in the browser with `AppicaUI.toast.add(...)`.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
A ToastTrigger fires a toast with a title and description; it slides in, waits, and
dismisses itself.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex justify-center") do
    ToastTrigger(toast: { title:, description:, icon: (icon.to_s unless icon.to_s == "none") }) { |trigger| Button(**trigger) { "Show toast" } }
  end
  Toaster(position:)
end

examples.name: With an icon
examples.notes:
`icon:` adds a filled, color-matched glyph (success, error, warning, info) while the
surface stays neutral.

examples.name: With a thumbnail
examples.notes: `thumbnail: true` wraps the icon in a tinted badge for more prominence.

examples.name: With an action
examples.notes:
`action:` adds an inline button - "Undo", "Retry", "View". Here it fires a follow-up
toast; in an app give it `href:`, an `event:` name, or an `onClick` from JavaScript.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex justify-center") do
    ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "Message archived", action: { label: "Undo", toast: { title: "Message restored" } } }) do |trigger|
      Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "Archive message" }
    end
  end
  Toaster()
end

examples.name: Promise
examples.notes:
`AppicaUI.toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` swaps the content as the promise
settles. (This demo fails at random to show both outcomes.)

examples.name: Positions
examples.notes:
A toast can target any of the six corners and edges with `position:`; it swipes toward
its nearest edge to dismiss. (The Toaster's `position:` sets the default.)
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "mx-auto grid max-w-md grid-cols-3 gap-2") do
    %w[ top-left top-center top-right bottom-left bottom-center bottom-right ].each do |position|
      ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "Notification", description: "Anchored #{position}.", position: }) do |trigger|
        Button(**trigger, variant: :outline, size: :sm) { position }
      end
    end
  end
  Toaster()
end

examples.name: Timeout & progress
examples.notes:
`timeout:` sets how long a toast lingers; `timeout: 0` keeps it until dismissed.
`progress: true` on the Toaster draws a countdown bar on auto-dismissing toasts.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2") do
    ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "Auto-dismiss", description: "This toast closes in 6 seconds.", timeout: 6000 }) { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "Timed (6s)" } }
    ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "Stays put", description: "Set timeout to 0 to keep a toast until dismissed.", timeout: 0 }) { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :outline) { "Persistent" } }
  end
  Toaster(progress: true)
end

examples.name: Server-rendered (flash)
examples.notes:
Toasts rendered with the page - e.g. from flash messages - animate in and time out like
any other. The same AppicaUI::Toast can be appended with a Turbo Stream.

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
The layout mirrors: the icon leads from the right, the close button moves to the left
and the progress bar drains in the reading direction.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "flex justify-center") do
    ToastTrigger(toast: { title: "حفظ التغييرات", description: "تم تحديث تفضيلاتك.", icon: "success" }) { |trigger| Button(**trigger) { "حفظ التغييرات" } }
    Toaster(progress: true, dir: "rtl", id: "toaster-rtl")
  end
end
